## Overview

Apple Inc. reported fiscal year 2026 revenue of $479 billion, marking an all-time record for the company. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=14] -->
Fourth-quarter revenue reached a September quarter record of $114.5 billion, representing a 12 percent year-over-year increase. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=12] -->
The company achieved record net income of $132.175 billion and diluted earnings per share of $2.10 for the fiscal year. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=364] -->
<!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=12] -->
Cash generated by operating activities totaled $145.097 billion in the fourth quarter. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=396] -->

## Market Positioning and Growth Outlook

**Demand Momentum (4/5)**
Apple’s installed base of active devices reached a new all-time high across all major product categories and geographic segments. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=14] -->
The company reported that Services revenue reached a new all-time high in the fourth quarter. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=9] -->
iPhone revenue also set a record for a September quarter, contributing to the overall top-line growth. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=13] -->
The 12 percent year-over-year revenue growth indicates strong consumer demand for hardware and services. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=12] -->

**Expansion Capacity (4/5)**
Apple introduced the iPhone Duo, described as the most transformational iPhone since the original, alongside iPhone 18 Pro models. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=13] -->
The company launched a new generation of hardware for the home and introduced Touch to Mac for the first time. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=13] -->
Strategic integration of the all-new Siri AI represents a significant software expansion across the device ecosystem. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=13] -->
Capital investment in property, plant, and equipment was $9.041 billion in the fourth quarter, supporting ongoing operational needs. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=409] -->

**Strategic Durability (4/5)**
Management cites very high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty as drivers of the record active device base. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=14] -->
The transition of CEO duties to John Ternus and Timothy D. Cook’s move to Executive Chair signals a controlled leadership transition. <!-- [source: line|file=10-K.txt|line=4843] -->
<!-- [source: line|file=10-K.txt|line=4862] -->
The company returned $28 billion to shareholders in the quarter through dividends and buybacks, demonstrating strong capital return capacity. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=14] -->

## Valuation Insights

**Profitability: 5/5**

Apple’s net sales grew 15.1% year over year to $478.8 billion for fiscal 2026, outpacing prior-year growth.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=478834000000;416161000000|result=0.1506|definition=Revenue growth] -->
Operating income rose to $158.1 billion, driven by a 1.7-point margin expansion to 33.0%.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=158063000000;478834000000|result=0.3301|definition=Operating margin] -->
Apple’s operating margin exceeds that of Microsoft (46.8% on a fiscal 2026 basis) and Meta (41.4% on a calendar 2025 basis), though Apple’s hardware-centric model yields a lower absolute margin than its software peers.
<!-- [source: xbrl|tag=us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss|period=2025-09-28:2026-09-26|value=158063000000] -->

**Cash Conversion: 5/5**

Cash from operations reached $145.1 billion, a 30.2% increase year over year, while capital expenditures fell to $9.0 billion.
<!-- [source: xbrl|tag=us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities|period=2025-09-28:2026-09-26|value=145097000000] -->
Free cash flow, defined as operating cash flow minus property and equipment additions, was $136.1 billion.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=145097000000;9041000000|result=136056000000|definition=Free cash flow] -->
This FCF conversion of 103% of net income indicates the company generates cash beyond its reported earnings, supporting aggressive capital returns.
<!-- [source: xbrl|tag=us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss|period=2025-09-28:2026-09-26|value=132175000000] -->

**Financial Strength: 4/5**

Return on average equity was 142.3%, calculated using fiscal 2026 net income of $132.2 billion and average stockholders' equity of $92.9 billion.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=132175000000;92913000000|result=1.4226|definition=Return on average equity] -->
Total debt-to-equity was 0.70x, reflecting a modest leverage position with $78.1 billion in total debt against $112.1 billion in equity.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=78114000000;112093000000|result=0.6969|definition=Debt to equity] -->
The balance sheet is further supported by a year-over-year reduction in total debt from $90.7 billion to $78.1 billion.
<!-- [source: xbrl|tag=us-gaap:LongTermDebtNoncurrent|period=2025-09-28:2026-09-26|value=68208000000] -->

**Valuation: 3/5**

At a user-provided price of $354.02, Apple trades at 39.4x trailing diluted EPS of $8.98.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=354.02;8.98|result=39.42|definition=P/E] -->
This multiple is below Microsoft’s approximately 44.4x (using $17.95 EPS) but above Meta’s 15.1x (using $23.49 EPS), reflecting market expectations for Apple’s premium hardware ecosystem.
<!-- [source: xbrl|tag=us-gaap:EarningsPerShareDiluted|period=2025-09-28:2026-09-26|value=8.98] -->

Apple’s fiscal 2026 fourth quarter delivered operating cash flow of $28 billion, which the company used to return $28 billion to shareholders.
<!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=14] -->

Insight: Apple generated $136.1 billion in free cash flow in fiscal 2026, a 39.1% year-over-year increase, supporting its ability to return $102.1 billion through dividends and buybacks without increasing leverage. <!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=145097000000;9041000000|result=136056000000|definition=Free cash flow] -->

## Future Developments and Strategic Recommendations

The upcoming holiday season is positioned as a critical period for the new iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro lineup. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=13] -->
Ongoing investment in Siri AI and Mac Touch interfaces aims to deepen ecosystem lock-in and differentiate Apple from competitors. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=13] -->
Investors should monitor whether the $28 billion in quarterly shareholder returns is sustainable relative to operating cash flow. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=14] -->
The favorable tariff refund impact on gross margin suggests potential margin volatility in future quarters as these one-time benefits fade. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=12] -->

Insight: The company's fourth-quarter operating cash flow of $145.097 billion significantly exceeded the $28 billion returned to shareholders, indicating substantial internal capital generation beyond buybacks. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=396] -->

## Investment Recommendation

Apple’s fiscal 2026 results demonstrate exceptional operating momentum and financial resilience. Growth quality is high, supported by a 15.1% year-over-year revenue increase to $478.8 billion and a 12% jump in fourth-quarter sales to a September record. <!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=478834000000;416161000000|result=0.1506|definition=Revenue growth] --> Profitability remains robust, with operating margin expanding to 33.0% and net income reaching $132.175 billion. <!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=158063000000;478834000000|result=0.3301|definition=Operating margin] --> Financial strength is evident in the 142.3% return on average equity and a modest 0.70x debt-to-equity ratio, aided by a debt reduction to $78.1 billion. <!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=132175000000;92913000000|result=1.4226|definition=Return on average equity] -->

The primary deciding metric is the 39.4x trailing P/E multiple, which prices in significant growth expectations despite the strong fundamentals. <!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=354.02;8.98|result=39.42|definition=P/E] --> While free cash flow of $136.1 billion easily covers the $102.1 billion returned to shareholders, the valuation offers limited margin of safety. The main risk is potential margin volatility as one-time tariff refund benefits fade, which could pressure the premium multiple. Given the durable growth but expensive valuation, the current price is fully justified but leaves little room for error.

**Rating: Hold**

Insight: Apple’s fiscal 2026 fourth quarter operating cash flow was $145.097 billion, a figure distinct from the $28 billion returned to shareholders. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=396] -->

8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L7: Apple reports fourth quarter results
8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L8: September quarter records for total company revenue, iPhone revenue, and EPS
8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L9: Services revenue reaches new all-time high
8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L10: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA — Apple
8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L11: ®
8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L12: today announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter ended September 26, 2026. The Company posted quarterly revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent year over year. Company gross margin was 47.9 percent, including a favorable impact of approximately 1 percentage point from tariff refunds. Diluted earnings per share was $2.10, up 14 percent year over year, and included a favorable impact of $0.05 from tariff refunds.
8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L13: “Today, Apple is proud to report a September quarter revenue record of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent from a year ago, with iPhone reaching a September quarter record and Services reaching an all-time high, capping off our best fiscal year ever,” said John Ternus, Apple’s CEO. “We’re closing the year with our most ambitious lineup yet. That includes the iPhone Duo, the most transformational iPhone since the original, alongside iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, our most powerful iPhones yet. We also just introduced a whole new generation of hardware for the home and brought Touch to Mac for the first time. Together with the all-new Siri AI, it’s an incredible lineup to carry us into the holiday season.”
8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L14: “Apple delivered September quarter records for net income and EPS. Our record September quarter capped off a strong fiscal 2026, with all-time record revenue of $479 billion and double-digit EPS growth,” said Kevan Parekh, Apple’s CFO. “We generated $28 billion in operating cash flow during the quarter, allowing us to return $28 billion to shareholders. Thanks to our very high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty, our installed base of active devices reached a new all-time high across all major product categories and geographic segments.”
8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L15: Apple’s board of directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.27 per share of the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on November 16, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 12, 2026.
8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt:L16: Apple will provide live streaming of its Q4 2026 financial results conference call beginning at 2:00 p.m. PT on November 2, 2026, at apple.com/investor/earnings-call. The webcast will be available for replay for approximately two weeks thereafter.
